item.tib: g.yag ru dgra chos kyis shog dril mde'u kha nyes byed dam nyams srog gshed
item.coloph: ces pas dgra chos shog dril mde'u kha 'di yang zang zang lha brag gi pha bong stag 'dra ba'i bswe sgrom nang nas dbyil ston khyung rgod rtsal gyis zab gter spyan drangs pa'o// ces pas tshul 'di yang shar rgyal mo rong du 'khrungs pa'i rgyal khyung dge bshes tsa'i gdung brgyud (rgyud)rtsa ba'i bla ma g.yung drung rgyal mtshan gyis/ shog dril gcig byung ba dbus rtsang (gtsang) la phab pa'i mdo smad du dar ba dge legs 'phel//
